#!/bin/bash
# Eval DeepSeek CWM repo-level s123 — 1-epoch checkpoint (checkpoint-4209)
# Purpose: verify early-stopping data cited in appendix (75.45% acc / 66.4% unparseable)
set -e
cd /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier

CKPT_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints_deepseek_cwm_repo_s123_v2/checkpoint-4209"
if [ ! -d "$CKPT_DIR" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Checkpoint not found: ${CKPT_DIR}"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Using checkpoint: $CKPT_DIR"

OUTDIR="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/deepseek_cwm_repo_s123_1epoch_eval"
mkdir -p "$OUTDIR"

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 /root/miniconda3/bin/python eval_repo_cwm.py \
    --checkpoint_dir "$CKPT_DIR" \
    --model_name /root/autodl-tmp/models/deepseek-ai/deepseek-coder-6.7b-instruct \
    --split test \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --max_seq_length 4096 \
    --max_new_tokens 512 \
    --batch_size 4 \
    --output_dir "$OUTDIR"

echo "Eval complete. Results in $OUTDIR"
python3 -c "
import json
results = [json.loads(l) for l in open('${OUTDIR}/results_incremental.jsonl')]
total = len(results)
unparseable = sum(1 for r in results if r.get('unparseable', False))
correct = sum(1 for r in results if r.get('correct', False) and not r.get('unparseable', False))
print(f'Total: {total}, Correct: {correct} ({100*correct/total:.2f}%), Unparseable: {unparseable} ({100*unparseable/total:.2f}%)')
if total > unparseable:
    print(f'Accuracy (excl unparseable): {100*correct/(total-unparseable):.2f}%')
sample = results[0]
gen_len = len(sample.get('gen_text', ''))
print(f'Sample gen_text length: {gen_len} chars (expect >100 for repo-level CWM)')
"
EOF
chmod +x /home/sonny/exec-sim-repair-verifier/eval_deepseek_cwm_s123_1epoch.sh
